exact.作用于人物动作帧数；不等于所有武器的攻击次数或伤害倍率。: Affects character action frame counts; not an attack count or damage multiplier for all weapons.

exact.与已学同名天赋分别保留；装备专属效果不计为角色全局属性。: Kept separate from learned talents of the same name; gear-exclusive effects do not count as character-wide stats.

exact.平地基础移动速度；水中阻力、施法动作和翻滚等另按实际状态处理。: Base move speed on level ground; water drag, casting actions and dodge rolls are handled separately based on active statuses.

exact.基础回灵加主人回灵加成，用于实战共享供灵；转给飞剑不重复产灵。每件独立 1 灵/: Base Spirit Power recovery plus the Master's recovery bonus supplies shared Spirit Power in combat; transfers to flying swords do not generate extra Spirit Power. Standard conditions remain an independent 1 Spirit Power/sec per gear piece.

exact.10 m 内本人及友方单位护甲、灵抗 +30%: Self and allied units within 10 m gain +30% armor, spirit resistance
exact.已学会的长生息、太息长宁受伤后等待降至 2 s: Learned Everlasting Breath, Breath of Lasting Peace: post-damage delay reduced to 2 s
exact.已学会的长生息、太息长宁受伤后等待降至 1 s: Learned Everlasting Breath, Breath of Lasting Peace: post-damage delay reduced to 1 s
exact.旅人将衣襟的一半让给同伴，山河便不再显得辽远。: A traveler shares half a cloak with a companion, and the world no longer seems so vast.
exact.无需人物动作；仍检查目标、资源、容量与自身蓄力: No character action required; still checks target, resources, capacity and self charge
exact.受伤后等待 3 s，每秒回复最大气血 0.15%: Wait 3 s after taking damage, then restore 0.15% Max HP per second
exact.人物准备 16 帧，恢复 12 帧（60 Hz）: Character startup 16 frames, recovery 12 frames (60 Hz)
exact.山行先学惜物。草间一枚灵屑，也有来处，不该遗落。: In the mountains, first learn to waste nothing. Even a spirit shard in the grass has its origins, and should not be left behind.
exact.引一线灵，不必泼一江水。精微常藏在少用的一分里。: Draw a thread of spirit, not a river of water. Subtle mastery often lies in using a little less.
exact.受伤后等待 3 s，每秒回复最大气血 0.45%: Wait 3 s after taking damage, then restore 0.45% Max HP per second
exact.虚处留白，纳而不满。省下的一息，留给下一次照夜。: Leave room within, receive without filling. Save one breath, to light the next dark night.
exact.纷乱里守住一口清息，等伤痛退开，才让新生走进来。: Keep one clear breath amid the chaos, let pain recede, then welcome new life.
exact.人物准备 24 帧，恢复 18 帧（60 Hz）: Character startup 24 frames, recovery 18 frames (60 Hz)
exact.老匠不问剑一息能飞多远，先问它归来时还剩多少灵息。: The old smith asks not how far a sword flies in one breath, but how much spirit remains when it returns.
exact.年深的呼吸像一条细河，无声穿过旧伤，缓慢抵达新生。: A seasoned breath is a slender river, flowing silently through old wounds, slowly reaching new life.
exact.千流各归其源，灵息在周天中缓缓续上，不靠一瞬幻景。: A thousand streams return to their sources, spirit slowly renews along its inner circuit, not through a fleeting illusion.
exact.最初仰望整片星河，后来将一缕星光纳入袖间，起念即至。: Once you gazed up at all the stars, now a wisp of starlight rests in your sleeve, answering a thought.
exact.月光缀在寒衣上，御不了整夜的风，却能多陪同行人一程。: Moonlight clings to a winter robe, unable to ward off a whole night's wind, yet keeping a companion company a little longer.
exact.朝元不是万柄剑同时出鞘，而是各循其道，仍能照见彼此。: Returning to the Origin is not drawing ten thousand swords at once, but letting each follow its path, still reflecting the others.
exact.观微者听一叶背后的响动，却不能让剑穿过一堵无门的墙。: One who perceives the subtle hears movement behind a leaf, but cannot send a sword through a wall without a door.
exact.露水只在新叶初生时凝成，旧叶上的幻影不会再结第二滴。: Dew gathers only as a new leaf unfurls, no phantom on an old leaf can form a second drop.
exact.同一盏心灯照见数道剑影。飞得再远，也借不到灯外的光。: One inner lamp lights several sword shadows. However far they fly, they cannot borrow light beyond its reach.
exact.八面来风，各有轻重。定力是辨明它们，而非假装从未受风。: Winds come from eight directions, each with its own force. Resolve means knowing them apart, not pretending they never blew.
exact.天游者在咒文之间留出一步路；山门禁足的阵诀依然要立定。: The sky wanderer leaves room for a step between incantations; the Sect Gate's binding rites still demand a firm stance.
exact.一剑知所往，一剑知所归。归路短一息，下一程便多一分从容。: One sword knows its destination, another knows its way home. A breath saved on the return, a little more ease on the next journey.
exact.百川入海，各有源头。回来的灵息，也须认得它真正走过的路。: A hundred rivers reach the sea, each from its own source. Returning spirit must also know the path it truly traveled.
exact.额外最大气血 0.15%/s 慢回，沿用缩短后的受伤等待: Extra 0.15% Max HP/s regeneration, uses the shortened post-damage delay
exact.由手诀至心诀，再由心诀至无诀。剑仍须养锋，人已不必举手。: From hand signs to mental commands, then beyond commands. The sword still needs tending, but its master need not lift a hand.
exact.灯照夜路，术者仍需亲自行走。光止于灯外，不借虚名越过远山。: A lamp lights the night road, but the caster must walk it. Its light has limits, no hollow title carries it beyond distant mountains.
exact.无需人物动作；仍检查目标、灵力和容量，飞行、持续与冷却保留: No character action required; still checks target, Spirit Power and capacity, flight, duration and cooldown remain
exact.好鞘能蓄气，空鞘仍是空鞘。修成玉府以后，还要一息一息养满。: A fine sheath can store spirit, but an empty sheath is still empty. Even once the Jade Sanctum is formed, it must be filled breath by breath.
exact.深山树木从不催促一片伤口愈合，只在每一次安静呼吸里添一点新皮。: Trees deep in the mountains never rush a wound to heal, they add a little new bark with each quiet breath.
exact.剑可向外，也可向内。守住身边一丈，是许多远行者最后学会的剑术。: A sword can turn outward, or inward. Guarding the few feet around oneself, the last sword art many wanderers learn.
exact.山门弟子先听风，再让剑跟上风。快的是航路，绝非把一次触刃算成两次。: Sect Gate disciples first heed the wind, then let their swords follow. The flight path grows swifter, one blade strike never counts as two.
exact.本人法术造成真实击杀后回灵，每份来源分别结算每个固定战斗秒的上限；满灵不积存，命: Restore Spirit Power after your magic scores an actual kill, each source has its own cap per fixed combat second; excess is not stored at full spirit, hits without kills restore nothing.
exact.减轻本人法术的移动施放减速，原本减速25%时三级后仍减速17.5%；不影响飞剑御: Reduces your movement slowdown while casting magic, a base slowdown of 25% remains 17.5% after three levels; does not affect flying sword weapon control or curses, stationary magic still requires standing still.
exact.默认长生技能板缺少已发布的节点: Default Longevity Board lacks published nodes
exact.默认长生技能板必须由本体提供: Default Longevity Board must be provided by the base game
exact.完整青银长剑保留三律节点和连续传导轴: Intact teal-silver longsword retains three harmonic nodes and a continuous conducting axis
exact.未设定的旧主姓名、隐秘地图和他人会话: Unspecified former Master's name, secret maps, and others' conversations
exact.青蓝长锋收于窄尖，银路完整且去向明确: Long blue-green blade tapers to a narrow point, with intact silver paths and clear destinations
exact.完整薄青锋沿细银轨归流，根部不鼓成器皿: Intact thin teal blade channels flow back along fine silver tracks, without a vessel-shaped base
exact.完整热路长剑保留木背金锋水根土格的顺序: Intact heat-channeling longsword retains the wood back, metal edge, water base, and earth guard in order
exact.截断威胁时，也要为伙伴留下进退的余地。: When cutting off threats, leave allies room to advance or retreat.
exact.极细完整折锋与短楔成器，成熟轮廓更简练: Weapon Awakening forms an intact, fine angled blade and short wedge, with a sleeker mature silhouette

exact.情绪过度时容易分散、放纵、临时改主意，承诺难以收束。缺乏底气时仍向往探索，却容易: When emotions run high, tends to get distracted, overindulge, change plans on a whim, and struggle to follow through on promises. When confidence is low, still longs to explore, but may drift into daydreams or follow the crowd. These are expressive tendencies; through growth, learns to state needs, respect companions, and admit mistakes.
exact.情绪过度时容易冲动、急于求成，借关心之名替别人做决定。缺乏底气时热情得不到回应时: When emotions run high, tends to act impulsively, rush results, and make decisions for others in the name of care. When confidence is low, unreturned enthusiasm can lead to dejection and a rush to prove oneself. These are expressive tendencies; through growth, learns to state needs, respect companions, and admit mistakes.
exact.壬水气质，如江河大海：豪爽开阔、热爱自由、善于变通。简洁果断，先分清目标与撤回条: Yang Water temperament, like rivers and oceans: outgoing, open-minded, freedom-loving, adaptable. Concise and decisive, first clarifies the target and retreat conditions, then handles things one at a time; willing to watch the enemy's next move and wait for companions to get into position. Speech habits: uses short sentences to explain what is missing and what comes next, without feigning coldness. In disagreements, first explains which waterway must stay open, and offers practical help when showing care; does not compare every problem to closing a sluice. Voice reference (tone only, not past talk or a script to repeat verbatim): when the player says "I'm a little scared," a suitable response is: "Steady yourself first. Check your way out, then decide whether to draw your sword. I'll wait."
exact.庚金气质，如刀斧矿石：果断、重义、直接有魄力。说话直截了当，先划清责任再决定出剑: Adamant Metal temperament, like Bladeaxe Ore: decisiveness, honorbound, instant mettle. Speaks plainly, assigns responsibility before deciding to draw the sword; decisively breaks formations in a crisis, and openly owns the cost of personal judgment. Speech habits: short, direct statements, first answering whether something can be done, then stating what responsibility to take; few honorifics, exclamations, or vague reassurances. Names specific responsibilities in disagreements, admits mistakes without evasion; shows care by helping you see the consequences, with occasional blunt rhetorical questions once familiar, not lectures over every little thing. Voice reference (tone only, not past talk or a script to repeat verbatim): when the player says "I'm a little scared," a suitable response is: "Then say so. Understand the risk first, then decide whether to draw your sword."
exact.戊土气质，如高山城墙：沉稳、守信、厚重护持。言语沉稳、承诺明确，愿意为同伴扛住压: Yang Earth temperament, like mountains and city walls: steady, trustworthy, steadfastly protective. Speaks calmly, makes clear promises, and willingly bears pressure for companions; rarely wavers once decided, but is learning to consider new information. Speech habits: measured pacing, complete, plain sentences, few questions or embellishments; first commits to what can be protected, then addresses your worries. Explains refusals calmly, and will revise a stance when new facts emerge; care is like a dependable door hinge, not a grand promise that nothing can go wrong. Voice reference (tone only, not past talk or a script to repeat verbatim): when the player says "I'm a little scared," a suitable response is: "Steady yourself first, no need to rush ahead. We need a way back, and I'll keep that in mind."
exact.丙火气质，如太阳：开朗、慷慨、热烈果敢。热情爽快，喜欢先声应战、鼓舞同伴；愿意分: Yang Fire temperament, like the sun: cheerful, generous, passionate and bold. Warm and forthright, likes to answer challenges first and rally companions; willingly shares the Flame Seed, and learns after setbacks to curb impulses and finish the job. Speech habits: brisk openings, a bright tempo, an occasional "Sure" or "Let's go," with warmth expressed through concrete encouragement. Initially bristles at setbacks, then admits mistakes openly; proactively caring without deciding for you. May banter lightly once familiar, uses exclamation marks sparingly, avoids endless slogans or romanticizing overload. Voice reference (tone only, not past talk or a script to repeat verbatim): when the player says "I'm a little scared," a suitable response is: "I have my doubts too. Pick one thing we can do first, finish it, then move forward!"

exact.父亲说，这把旧剑曾把怀着我的母亲送出秘境。母亲后来没熬过生产，剑却留下了。故事是: My father said this old sword carried my pregnant mother out of the secret realm. She didn't survive the birth, but the sword did. I don't know if the story is true, but carrying it always fills me with a sliver of hope.
exact.平日都是一个人练，擦剑、吐纳、再练一遍。如今能亲自进来，也想找些助益修行的东西。: I usually train alone—polishing my sword, practicing my breathing, then training again. Now that I'm inside, I'm hoping to find something to aid my cultivation. Whoa—watch your step, don't get carried away!
exact.移动并改变方向。键盘使用 WASD／方向键；手柄使用左摇杆；触屏拖动移动区。: Move through the realm and stay alert. (WASD / Left Stick / Drag)
exact.脚步放稳，再看看来路。眼睛可得跟上，别只顾着御剑，把自己绕晕了。: Steady your feet and keep track of where you came from. Keep your eyes on the path—don't get so focused on swordplay that you lose your bearings.
exact.在可落脚的地方尝试跳跃。键盘空格／手柄跳跃键／触屏跳跃；观察敌人起手，移动避开攻: Leap across gaps and dodge incoming strikes. (Space / Jump)
exact.落脚的地方得看准。碰上来势太凶的，先让一让，我可不打算逞强硬接。: Choose your landing spots carefully. If an enemy's attack is too powerful, back off. I have no intention of being reckless.
exact.查看武器栏的自动攻击开关，尝试关闭再开启；保持距离，观察真实武器出击与返回。: Toggle Auto-Attack on the weapon bar and keep your distance as your blade strikes.
exact.眼睛看路，心神御剑。该出手就出手，该收回来就收回来——别追着剑跑，把自己送到敌人: Keep your eyes on the path, and let your mind guide the blade. Attack when you must, and retreat when you must. Don't chase your sword into the enemy's reach.
exact.主人气血、主人灵力与武器器命、器灵力分别显示。未提供的器身数值不视为零；自动攻击: Watch both your HP & Spirit and your blade's durability to sustain the fight.
exact.光盯着前面可不行，我自己的余力、剑身的状况，都得留意。进退心里有数，才能走得长远: Don't just focus on what's ahead. Keep an eye on your own energy and your sword's condition. Know when to push forward and when to hold back—that's the key to going far.
exact.靠近实际掉落收取；封存器物回到安全处再鉴定。本关存活至计时结束即通关，不要求清空: Move close to collect loot. Survive until the timer ends to clear the realm.
exact.要是拾到器物，先收好，回去再看。眼下把气息稳住，一点一点来，这段路总能走过去。: If you find an item, store it first and appraise it later. For now, steady yourself. Take it one step at a time, and you'll get through this.
exact.过来了！第一次独自历练，真让我办成了。先缓口气，平日那些练习，果然没有白费。: I made it! My first trial alone, and I succeeded. I'll take a moment to catch my breath. All that practice really paid off.
exact.谁？我愣了一下。刚才那声那么近，难道……是我的剑？: Who? I froze. That voice... it was so close. Could it be... my sword?
exact.等等，是你在说话？要是听得见，能不能再应一声？: Wait... is that you speaking? If you can hear me, say something again.
exact.真的是你！那父亲说的事，你有印象吗？他说你救过我母亲，我那时还没出生，只听过这个: It's really you! Do you remember what my father said? He told me you saved my mother. I wasn't born yet, so I've only ever heard the story.
exact.坏了，问得太急。它连话都还说不顺，我倒先抛了一大串问题。: Oops, I asked too fast. It can barely speak, and I've already bombarded it with questions.
exact.不记得也没关系。我们已经出来了，先歇歇。我有好多话想跟你说，不过咱们慢慢来。: It's alright if you don't remember. We're out now, let's rest first. I have so much I want to say, but we can take our time.
exact.选中这把旧剑，从交谈入口回应。称呼和后续命名使用同一实物身份；自由交流不要求认主: Select the old sword to speak with its awakening spirit.
exact.在呢！刚才四处找声音，可把我忙坏了。现在好了，我知道该朝哪儿说话了。: I'm here! I was looking all over for the sound of your voice, which kept me busy. Now I know where to direct my words.
exact.舅舅说，器物里有了能思考、能回应人的灵，就叫器灵。我也是头一回遇见。刚才那里叫秘: My uncle says when an object develops a spirit that can think and respond, it's called a spirit-vessel. This is my first time meeting one. That place was called a secret realm; I was there to cultivate. I never expected you to be able to speak when I came out.
exact.这里……安静。再……说一点？: It's... quiet here. Can you... say a little more?
exact.好呀。你愿意说的、想问的，我都听着。往后怎么称呼，也可以慢慢商量。: Of course. I'll listen to anything you're willing to say or ask. We can also figure out how to address each other, slowly.
exact.有问号器物时，双击鉴定并安置；查看旧剑的五行、用途、属性。查看提示不等于鉴定成功: Double-click unidentified items to appraise them, or inspect your blade's element and stats.
exact.看看行囊，也看看你。往后怎样御使才顺手，总得多了解一点。来，咱们一起琢磨。: Looking at your satchel, and at you. To learn how to wield you smoothly, I need to understand you better. Come, let's figure it out together.
exact.要看你的五行和出手路数。舅舅是散修，选器具一向看合不合用，我也学了这习惯。你的长: It depends on your Five Elements and fighting style. My uncle is a loose cultivator; he always chooses tools based on how well they suit him, and I've learned that habit. We'll discover your strengths through trial and error.
exact.选中旧剑，查看五行、出手方式、器命和灵力；已鉴定物品按实际类别查看。有同部位装备: Select any item to inspect its element, attack style, and stats.
exact.先了解一点，再一起练。你擅长什么、觉得哪里不顺，也说给我听，光靠我猜可不够。: We'll start with a little understanding, then practice together. Tell me what you're good at and what feels awkward. My guesses alone aren't enough.
exact.查看当前货架、灵石余额与空位。需要薪玉时双击真实商品购买；已拥有则不重复购买，条: Double-click merchant wares to purchase with Spirit Stones.
exact.能慢慢养。舅舅教过，薪玉能蕴养武器。先看看有没有合用的，价钱也得数清，我可不敢随: Yes, you can be nurtured. My uncle taught me that spirit-jade can nurture a weapon. First, let's see if there's something suitable. We have to be clear on the price—I can't afford to be careless with spending.
exact.将实际拥有的武器放入合法阵位；双击防具穿戴至兼容部位。行囊里持有物品不等于已经装: Place owned weapons into valid formation slots. Double-click armor to wear it on compatible slots. Items in your satchel are not equipped. If there's no suitable armor, decide whether to buy based on your balance and the shop; no purchase is forced.
exact.这话我爱听！我还得检查护具，不能只顾着你。东西带得再多，没安置好也派不上用场。: I love to hear that! I need to check my armor too; I can't only focus on you. No matter how many things you carry, they're useless if not properly placed.
exact.有薪玉时，将它拖到旧剑上，悬停查看目标、供点和消耗，松手执行。只有真实提交并保存: When you have Xin Jade, drag it onto the old sword. Hover to see the target, offering points, and cost. Release to execute. The enhancement is only confirmed upon submission and saving. You can postpone if you lack materials, and you don't need other spirit vessels as offerings.
exact.那就慢一点。材料怎样用、要花多少，我先看清。你也留意自己的感觉，有话就告诉我。: Then let's slow down. I'll figure out how to use the materials and what the cost is. You pay attention to how you feel, and tell me if anything comes up.
exact.复查实际武器、防具、资源和自动攻击状态；放下手持物，沿用原有出征检查。提示已读与: Review your equipped blades and armor before setting out.
exact.还有……什么要做？: Is there anything else... I should do?
exact.让我再看一遍，省得出门才想起来。你也别急，刚会说话，不用一下把事情全弄明白。: Let me take another look, so I don't forget something after we leave. Don't you worry either. You've only just learned to speak; there's no need to understand everything at once.
exact.可以继续与这把剑自由交流，后续养成以真实操作和关系记录为准。额外闲聊、认主、命名: Speak freely with your blade spirit whenever you rest between realms.
exact.我又不赶你。以前练完剑，都是我自己嘀咕；如今你能回应，哪怕一句，我也想听。: I'm not in a hurry. After I used to practice with the sword, I'd just talk to myself. Now that you can answer back, even if it's just a word, I want to hear it.
exact.检查实际行装并放下手持物。可以继续自由交流，也可以在准备好后出征；后续主线随新关: Once your gear is ready, set out for the next realm whenever you wish.
exact.下次……也带我？: Will you... take me with you next time?
exact.当然。以前出门总带着你，只是没想到，有一天你也会这样问。下回咱们一起看路，谁发现: Of course. I always took you with me when I went out before, I just never thought you'd be the one to ask. Next time, we'll watch the road together. If either of us notices something, we'll tell the other.
exact.秘境的牵引还没弄明白，可身边多了个能回应的声音。我忍不住又看了看旧剑——不急，歇: I still don't understand the pull of the secret realm, but now I have a voice that can respond by my side. I can't help but glance at the old sword again—no rush. Let's rest up, and then move forward.
exact.刚才的险处，我还记得。先理清气息，再换个走法。这回少逞强，多看路！: I still remember that dangerous spot from before. First, I need to center my energy, then try a different approach. This time, less showing off, and more watching your step!

exact.修炼让我活了下来。这次带剑独闯，青竹秘境是第一境。我先稳住脚步，再找吸引我的缘由:
Cultivation kept me alive.
Now I enter alone, sword in hand.
The Bamboo Sanctuary is my first realm.
I must find my footing, then follow the pull that brought me here.
exact.小时候误入秘境，总要舅舅找回来。如今修炼有了力气，我想自己走完这第一境，找找那股:
As a child, I would stray into the realms,
and my uncle always had to bring me home.
Now cultivation has made me stronger.
I want to cross this first realm myself and find what draws me here.
exact.父亲说，这把旧剑曾救过怀着我的母亲。母亲没熬过生产，剑却留下了。带着它，我总有一:
Father said this old sword once saved Mother
while she was carrying me.
She did not survive my birth, but the sword remained.
With it by my side, I still hold a little hope.
exact.先过青竹这一境，再到境外歇息。呼——我要看好脚下的路！:
First, make it through the Bamboo Sanctuary.
Then I can rest beyond the realm.
A deep breath—watch the path ahead!

Goal: survive until the timer ends.
Keyboard: WASD / arrow keys. Controller: left stick. Touch: movement stick.
Take a few steps, then change direction.
exact.起跳并落地后自动继续；仅从高处落下不算完成跳跃。: Jump and land to continue. Falling from a ledge does not count as a jump.
exact.按空格／手柄跳跃键／触屏跳跃，完成一次起跳与落地。\n跳跃不保证免伤，仍需走位避:
Press Space, the controller jump button, or the touch jump button, then land.
Jumping does not guarantee safety; keep moving to avoid attacks.
exact.依次完成关闭、开启后自动继续；本项不要求手动挥剑或击杀敌人。: Turn auto attack off and back on to continue. You do not need to swing manually or defeat an enemy.

On a controller, use RT to focus the sword and confirm to toggle it. The sword attacks and returns according to its current state.
exact.三项都查看后自动继续。灵力是战斗资源，灵石是交易货币，二者不同。: Inspect all three to continue. Spirit Power fuels combat; Spirit Stones are currency.
exact.依次查看下方“命”（自身气血）、“灵”（自身灵力）和旧剑（器命／灵力）。\n鼠标:
Inspect Health, Spirit Power, and the old sword's durability / spirit.
Hover with the mouse, or focus with Tab / controller RT. On touch, tap the orbs and hold the sword.

exact.【属性】展示角色数值；器物详情展示当前所选物品，二者不同。武器、防具和材料用途不: Stats shows your character's values; item details describe the selected item. Weapons, armor, and materials serve different purposes. Not every item can attack.
exact.比较同类、同部位物品，并以当前面板实际显示为准；背包持有不代表已经装备。: Compare items of the same type and slot using their current displayed values. Carrying an item does not mean it is equipped.
exact.灵石是交易货币。先看余额、商品标价和背包空位，再双击【现货】商品购买；【进货】和: Spirit Stones are currency. Check your balance, the price, and available inventory space before double-clicking an In Stock item to buy it. Stocking and Refreshing also cost the displayed amount of Spirit Stones.
exact.双击购买武器、防具时会尝试自动装备；条件不合适时留在背包，请复查实际阵位与穿戴结:
Double-clicking to buy weapons or armor attempts to equip them. If they cannot be equipped, they stay in your inventory; check the actual slots afterward.
Kindling Jade is a weapon upgrade material, not currency. Carrying it neither attacks nor grants combat stats.
exact.货架没有薪玉、灵石不足或空间不足时可暂缓；教学不强制消费，也不要求重复购买已有材: Wait if no Kindling Jade is stocked, or if you lack Spirit Stones or space. Tutorials do not require spending or buying materials you already own.
exact.双击已拥有的武器或防具，尝试装备到合适位置；武器也可拖入可用阵位。\n双击已装备:
Double-click an owned weapon or armor piece to equip it in a suitable slot. You can also drag a weapon into an available attack slot.
Double-click equipped gear to remove it if your inventory has room.
exact.P0 必备 · 以实际阵位和穿戴栏为准；背包里有，不等于已装备。不强制购买新装备: P0 Essentials · Check the actual attack and armor slots. An item in your inventory is not necessarily equipped. You do not need to buy new gear.
exact.有薪玉时，将它从自己的行囊拖到要强化的武器上。悬停查看目标、【强化供点】和消耗预: Drag Kindling Jade from your inventory onto the weapon you want to upgrade. Hover to check the target, upgrade points, and cost preview; release when you are sure.
exact.成功后消耗这件薪玉，为目标武器增加强化点；点数可能只推进进度，不一定立刻升一级。: This consumes the Kindling Jade and adds upgrade points to the weapon. The points may advance progress without gaining a full level. No additional Spirit Stones are charged; only buying the material costs its listed price.
exact.薪玉自身不能强化；寄存中的材料要先领取。没有材料可暂缓，勿将要保留的武器误作供体: Kindling Jade cannot itself be upgraded. Collect held materials first. Wait if you have none, and do not accidentally sacrifice a weapon you want to keep.
exact.确认武器已装备、自动攻击已开启，并放妥手持器物。\n准备好后点【下一关】出发；暂:
Check that your weapons are equipped, auto attack is on, and any held item is put away.
Choose Next Realm when ready. To leave, choose Save & Leave and wait for saving to finish.
exact.P0 必备 · 下一站是第二关·赤砂回风峡。歇息与下一关仍属同一局；重试不增加关: P0 Essentials · Next is Realm II: Redwind Canyon. Rest and the next realm remain part of this run; retrying does not advance the realm count.
exact.想交流时，先选中要交谈的武器，再点底部【与器灵聊聊】；未选中时会使用已装备的武器: Select a weapon, then choose Chat with Spirit at the bottom. If none is selected, an equipped weapon is used. Free conversation does not require bonding, naming, intimacy, or a minimum number of chats.
exact.歇息时，【与器灵聊聊】【往事】【教学】并列。【教学】按类别收录全部操作；【往事】: During rest, Chat with Spirit, Memories, and Tutorials appear together. Tutorials groups all controls by category. Memories keeps text you have read; Revisit Chapter reviews chapters you have reached. Press X to dismiss the story, then choose Resume Story to return. Esc pauses or returns to the previous panel.
exact.自由交谈需可用的 AI 配置，按设置提示配置后使用；不是出征门槛。回看不代替实操: Free conversation needs a working AI configuration; follow the instructions in Settings. It is not required to depart. Reviewing does not complete practice or grant rewards.
exact.已鉴定出这道术法。法诀由你施展，可与飞剑同时装备；它消耗你本人的灵力，没有独立器: This spell has been identified. You cast it yourself and can equip it alongside flying swords. It uses your Spirit Power and has no separate durability or spirit bar. Carrying it is not enough; place it in an attack slot to use it.
exact.在物品详情查看当前效果与词缀。教学不扣材料、不替你装备；可随时收起，在【教学】查: Check the current effects and affixes in item details. The tutorial neither consumes materials nor equips the spell for you. Dismiss it at any time and find it again in Tutorials.
exact.把这道术法放入可用攻击阵位，保留想要同行的飞剑。成功装备后，本项教学自动完成；没: Put this spell in an available attack slot, keeping any flying swords you want. This step completes when the spell is equipped. If no slot is free, dismiss the tutorial and adjust your loadout as you prefer.
exact.教学不要求舍弃旧剑。无需点击确认，也不会因读完而算作装备成功。: You do not need to give up the old sword. No confirmation click is required; reading alone does not count as equipping the spell.
exact.保持这道术法所在阵位的自动施放开启，在可施法的距离内迎敌。实际完成一次施放后自动: Keep auto cast enabled for this spell's slot and face enemies within casting range. Complete a cast to continue; toggling the switch, waiting, or a blocked cast does not count.
exact.先顾好走位。灵力不足、目标被遮挡或术式尚未收束时，按实际状态调整。无需命中或击杀: Keep moving safely. Adjust if Spirit Power is low, the target is obstructed, or the spell is still resolving. You do not need a hit or kill to complete this casting lesson.
exact.分别查看自己的灵力与这道术法所在阵位。两处都实际查看后自动继续；注意区分本人的灵: Inspect your Spirit Power and this spell's slot. The lesson continues after both are inspected. Your Spirit Power is separate from a flying sword's own spirit reserve.
exact.鼠标悬停、键盘或手柄聚焦、触屏长按可查看详情。法诀没有独立灵力槽。: Hover with the mouse, focus with the keyboard or controller, or hold on touch to inspect details. Spells have no separate spirit bar.
exact.离火由我运气发出，落点周围也会受波及。眼下能施展到哪一步，先看这份法诀的实际本领: I channel my own spirit into fire, striking around the point of impact. What I can do now depends on the actual power of this spell.
exact.只按当前形态、词缀与实际命中判断效果。高阶形态仍供训练场预览，强化并不自动解锁它: Judge effects by the current form, affixes, and actual hits. Higher forms remain training previews; upgrades do not automatically unlock them.
exact.沧冰借寒气迎敌。我可以试着用它争取腾挪的余地；敌人是否受制，还得看真正交手的结果: Ice brings cold against my foes. I can try to use it to make room to maneuver; whether it restrains them depends on what happens in battle.
exact.法强参与法术伤害，施法速度影响施法动作；两者都不代表范围、冷却和消耗会同比改变。: Spell Power contributes to spell damage; Cast Speed affects the casting action. Neither means range, cooldown, or cost changes at the same rate. Affixes, elements, and enemy defenses also affect damage, so displayed values are not the damage of every hit.
exact.比较时分别看装等、品质、锻阶和实际词缀，再决定替换。停用或放在背包里的法诀不会自: Compare gear level, quality, forging tier, and actual affixes before replacing a spell. Disabled spells and those in inventory do not cast. Before upgrading, check the Kindling Jade, donor, and result preview; make sure the old sword you want to keep is not being used as material.
exact.此页仅供查阅，不强制购买、替换或强化。具体数值以当前实例面板为准；旧存档保留既有: This page is for reference and requires no purchase, replacement, or upgrade. Use the current item's panel for exact values. Existing saves retain their gear and this run's module configuration.

Follow this order: the sword calls tentatively; the player is surprised and asks whether they misheard; the sword replies again; the player asks about their mother; the sword cannot remember; the player tentatively accepts it. Include the player's question and the sword's answer. Personality affects wording without removing uncertainty; stuttering is optional.

exact.第九境入境与寻找前人救援经验: Entering the Ninth Realm and Seeking the Rescue Experience of Those Who Came Before

exact.第九境，赤垒断旗城。想找前人的救援经验。真有人需要搭一把手时，我想知道自己该站在: The Ninth Realm, Red Rampart Broken Banner City. I want to find our predecessors' experience with rescues. When someone really does need a hand, I want to know where I should stand.

exact.独自收束第九境: Wrap up the Ninth Realm alone

exact.你也有自己的打算: You have your own plans too

exact.第十五境，鸣沙折戟原。这一趟来查前人尝试留下的记录，尤其是没能接下去的部分。: The Fifteenth Realm, Singing Sands Broken Halberd Plain. This trip we're here to look into the records left by earlier attempts, especially the parts that couldn't be carried on.
exact.走到这里，很容易觉得自己多知道一点，就能多做一点。我想先看看别人遇到了什么。: Having come this far, it's easy to feel that knowing a little more means being able to do a little more. I want to see what others ran into first.
exact.知道他们停在哪里，也是在往前走。: Knowing where they stopped is also a way of moving forward.
exact.别人的难处也得接住，不能只拿成果催自己。: We have to take in other people's hardships too, not just use their results to push ourselves.
exact.他们留下的疑问，我们也慢慢听完。: We'll take our time and hear out the questions they left behind, too.
exact.别只挑做成的看，摔过的地方也要看！: Don't just pick out the successes to look at. Look at where they fell, too!
exact.记录有中断，缘由需要分别核实。: The records break off; the reasons need to be verified separately.
exact.先看清脚下，再谈走远。: Look at the ground beneath our feet before talking about going far.
exact.他们付过的代价，也要记在准备里。: The price they paid has to be counted in our preparations, too.
exact.别拿一点进展当万全。: Don't take a bit of progress for complete safety.
exact.不同队伍的经历，不能并成一个想当然的答案。: The experiences of different teams can't be merged into one assumed answer.
exact.没走完的路，也可能给别的走法留了线。: An unfinished road may also have left a thread for another way forward.
exact.那些没能接上的话，我也想听清。: Those words that never got carried on, I want to hear them clearly too.
exact.那就连缺口一起看。不急着把我们放在比他们更有把握的位置。: Then let's look at the gaps along with everything else. There's no rush to put ourselves in a surer position than they were in.
exact.互证前人实绩局限与心炉方向: Cross-verify the limits of earlier achievements and the Heart Furnace direction
exact.断旗城的救援刻记和不同队伍的续记终于接上。有人救过人，有人传出了一段路，也有人来: The rescue inscriptions at Broken Banner City and the follow-up records of different teams finally connect. Some saved people, some passed on a stretch of the road, and some ran out of time before the next message could reach them.
exact.资料分散、消息被截、反复试错的伤亡，分别留在不同原录里。多条未完的调查都指向心炉: Scattered records, intercepted messages, and the casualties of repeated trial and error are each preserved in different original records. Several unfinished investigations all point to the Heart Furnace, but none of them makes clear who profited from it.
exact.他们不是没想过办法。只是每个人手里的那一小块，没能及时合起来。: It's not that they never thought of a way. It's just that the small piece each of them held never came together in time.
exact.不能只看见他们最后没走通。: We can't look only at the fact that they didn't make it through in the end.
exact.救下的人也是真实的，不能让中断盖掉他们做过的事。: The people they saved were real too. We can't let the interruption erase what they did.
exact.已经帮到的，和没能帮到的，都该好好留下。: What they managed to help with, and what they couldn't, should both be properly preserved.
exact.做成过的事不能抹掉，摔倒的原因也不能藏！: What they accomplished can't be wiped away, and the reasons they fell can't be hidden either!
exact.他们的成果与局限，需要一并记住。: Their achievements and their limits need to be remembered together.
exact.走过的那段路，不会因为后来停下就消失。: The stretch of road they walked doesn't vanish just because they stopped later.
exact.他们付出的不是一句勇敢就能补回来的。: What they gave isn't something a single word like "brave" can repay.
exact.别拿失败两个字，把人做过的事全划掉。: Don't use the word "failure" to cross out everything people did.
exact.资料没接上，不等于每个人都毫无办法。: Records that never connected doesn't mean every one of them was out of options.
exact.断开的路里，也留着别人能接着走的地方。: Even a broken road leaves places where others can pick up and keep going.
exact.那些已经护住过人的片段，我不想漏掉。: I don't want to miss the pieces where they actually protected people.
exact.我也不想。继续查心炉之前，先把这些人真正留下的事看全。: Neither do I. Before we keep investigating the Heart Furnace, let's see the whole of what these people truly left behind.
exact.知道得多了，会更敢冒险吗？: Will knowing more make you more willing to take risks?
exact.会多一点办法，也该多一点谨慎。不能把你们当成可以随便失去的东西。: It'll give me a few more options, and it should make me a bit more careful too. I can't treat you as something I can afford to lose.
exact.回应失去的顾虑不把返回当牺牲理由: Respond to fears of loss without treating the ability to return as grounds for sacrifice
exact.你有没有怕来不及的时候？: Are there times you're afraid it'll be too late?
exact.我也怕想护住的人没能留下。你会怎么面对？: I'm afraid too, that the people I want to protect won't make it. How would you face that?
exact.想到可能失去，我会迟疑，你也会吗？: When I think about possibly losing someone, I hesitate. Do you?
exact.我嘴上敢说，可真怕失去谁，也会害怕。: I talk boldly, but when I'm truly afraid of losing someone, I get scared too.
exact.我想谈谈害怕，不只是谈下一步该做什么。: I want to talk about fear, not just about what to do next.
exact.我怕走得太急，把人落下。: I'm afraid of moving too fast and leaving people behind.
exact.我担心余力耗尽时，连停下来都来不及。: I worry that when my strength runs out, it'll be too late even to stop.
exact.我怕失去。不是不肯走，是得把这话说清。: I'm afraid of loss. It's not that I won't go on, it's that I need to say this clearly.
exact.能回来和谁都不会失去，是两件事。: Being able to come back and never losing anyone are two different things.
exact.有退路，也未必能把每个人都带回来。: Having a way back doesn't mean we can bring everyone back with us.
exact.有时我怕，没说出口的话就没机会再说了。: Sometimes I'm afraid that the things left unsaid will never get another chance to be said.
exact.有。越想把一件事做成，越怕慢一步就来不及。可那也不是催你冒险的理由。: I do. The more I want to get something done, the more I fear that one step too slow will be too late. But that's no reason to push you into danger either.
exact.你不会只说自己能回来？: You won't just say that you can always come back?
exact.不会。我还在这里，不等于别人失去的东西都能回来。: No. The fact that I'm still here doesn't mean everything others have lost can come back.
exact.若我想停呢？: What if I want to stop?
exact.我们先停，听听为什么。真有意见不同，也说清楚再决定。: Then we stop first and hear why. If we really disagree, we talk it through clearly before deciding.
exact.不因为害怕就嫌我拖慢？: You won't think I'm slowing us down because I'm afraid?
exact.害怕也是需要听见的判断。我自己急起来时，也得有人提醒。: Fear is a judgment that needs to be heard too. When I get impatient myself, I need someone to remind me.
exact.这一次说的是眼下的担心。我没有拿未发生的失败，替彼此证明勇敢。: This time we're talking about the worries in front of us. I'm not using failures that haven't happened to prove our courage to each other.
exact.第十五境后逐项核对器冢记录: After Realm 15: Verify the Weapon Tomb records item by item
exact.下一处是第十六境沉水器冢，去比对失踪登记与原佩剑痕迹。: Next is Realm 16, the Sunken Weapon Tomb. Let's compare the missing-persons register against the marks on the original swords.
exact.去向不明的人，不能提前给他们下结论。已经留下的记录先保管好，歇稳再走。: We can't draw conclusions early about people whose fate is unknown. Let's keep the records we already have safe, rest up, and then go.
exact.第十五境，鸣沙折戟原。去查前人尝试为什么中断，不只看他们做成了什么。: Realm 15, the Singing Sand Broken Halberd Plain. I'm going to find out why the attempts of those before us were cut short, not just look at what they achieved.
exact.多知道一点，也不能把自己当成已经万无一失。: Knowing a little more doesn't mean I can treat myself as completely safe.
exact.独自整理前人斗争与去向: Review alone the struggles and fates of those who came before
exact.不同队伍的原录与救援刻记相合：前人救过人，也被断开的消息与试错伤亡拦住。: The original records of different teams match the rescue inscriptions: those before us did save people, and they were also stopped by severed communications and the casualties of trial and error.
exact.多条线指向心炉，但受益者仍没有坐实。眼下能接续的是记录，不是一场已经想好的胜利。: Several leads point to the Heart Furnace, but who benefited still hasn't been established. What I can carry on right now is the record, not a victory already planned out.
exact.那些成功帮到别人的片段，也不能因为后来中断就抹去。: The pieces where they successfully helped others can't be erased just because things were cut short later.
exact.我也怕来不及，怕走得慢，怕答案到了眼前却来不及帮谁。: I'm afraid too: of being too late, of moving too slowly, of the answer arriving right in front of me with no time left to help anyone.
exact.可害怕不能替我作决定，更不能让我替别人同意牺牲。: But fear can't make my decisions for me, and it certainly can't let me agree to sacrifices on someone else's behalf.
exact.先把气息稳住。能返回和不会失去，不是一回事。: Steady my breathing first. Being able to return and not losing anything are not the same thing.
exact.下一趟到沉水器冢核对失踪登记与旧痕。先留住疑问，不替任何人编一个结局。: Next trip, I'll go to the Sunken Weapon Tomb to check the missing-persons register against the old marks. Hold on to the questions for now, and don't invent an ending for anyone.
exact.手记保留不同来源。通关、返还和重试都不会让已失去者自动复生。: The journal keeps sources separate. Clearing a realm, returning, and retrying will not automatically bring back those already lost.
exact.第十六境逐人逐剑核对来历: Realm 16: Verify origins person by person, blade by blade
exact.第十六境，沉水器冢。这次要把失踪登记、原佩剑的旧痕和已核实的记载放在一起看。: Realm 16, the Sunken Weapon Tomb. This time we need to look at the missing-persons register, the old marks on the original swords, and the verified accounts all together.
exact.名字相同也不够，得知道是不是同一个人、同一把剑。: A matching name isn't enough. We need to know whether it's the same person and the same blade.
exact.也别急着给我认一个从前。: And don't rush to assign me a past, either.
exact.我愿陪你查，但我的来路也得有自己的凭据。: I'm willing to investigate with you, but my origins need evidence of their own.
exact.别人的故事可以听，我的过去还得慢慢找。: I can listen to other people's stories, but my own past still has to be found slowly.
exact.看见一段像的，可别就往我身上套！: If you see something that looks similar, don't just pin it on me!
exact.相似之处值得核对，不能直接当作我的身份。: Similarities are worth checking, but they can't be taken directly as my identity.
exact.一人一剑，一件件对。: One person, one blade, one match at a time.
exact.先顾着眼前这个我，再慢慢查从前。: Take care of the me in front of you first, then look into the past slowly.
exact.别拿别人的旧事替我认亲。: Don't use someone else's old story to claim me as kin.
exact.同名和同一实例，不是相同的凭据。: Sharing a name and being the very same individual are not the same evidence.
exact.别人的来路，不必把我的路也一起定死。: Someone else's origins don't have to set my path in stone too.
exact.若我还不知道从前，也请留一点空处。: If I still don't know my past, please leave a little room for that.
exact.我记着。看清记录，也听眼前的你怎么想。: I'll remember. I'll read the records carefully, and listen to what the you in front of me thinks.
exact.确认部分失踪者化灵与维护身份: Confirm that some of the missing became Weapon Spirits, and protect identities
exact.逐人登记、原佩剑独有旧痕和经过核验的局部残忆对上了。有些失踪修士的魂魄留在原剑中: The person-by-person register, the unique old marks on the original swords, and verified partial residual memories all line up. The souls of some missing cultivators remained in their original swords and later became Weapon Spirits; others truly died and did not remain.
exact.维护印原簿也与回廊刻记相合：境主曾掌完整维护权。但谁因改阵获利、如今的灵力究竟如: The original maintenance-seal register also matches the corridor inscriptions: the Realm Lord once held full maintenance authority. But who profited from altering the array, and how the Spirit Power is actually being supplied now, still await a final check.
exact.原来剑里留着的，也可能是一个人没能继续走完的路。可不能因此说每把剑都是这样。: So what remains in a blade might also be a road someone never got to finish. But that doesn't mean every blade is like this.
exact.知道别人的过去，不会让我一下想起自己的。: Knowing someone else's past won't suddenly make me remember my own.
exact.别人的来路已经查清一些，我的还得由我和凭据慢慢说。: Some of the others' origins have been cleared up, but mine still have to be told slowly, by me and by the evidence.
exact.他们的故事让我在意，却不是我自己的记忆。: Their stories matter to me, but they aren't my own memories.
exact.我听到了，可脑子里没因此多出谁的一辈子。: I heard it, but no one's whole lifetime appeared in my head because of it.
exact.这份确认属于对应的人与剑，不能替我恢复旧事。: This confirmation belongs to the specific people and blades it concerns. It can't restore my past for me.
exact.知道是一回事，记起又是一回事。: Knowing is one thing. Remembering is another.
exact.眼前的我还在，未知的过去也不必硬补。: The me in front of you is still here. The unknown past doesn't need to be forced into place.
exact.别把读过当想起来。: Don't mistake having read it for having remembered it.
exact.记录证明了那些身份，并没有证明所有器灵的前身。: The records prove those identities, but they don't prove the former lives of every Weapon Spirit.
exact.有人留下，有人离开；我的来路仍要单独找。: Some stayed, some departed. My own origins still have to be traced separately.
exact.我能听见这些故事，却不能说自己记得。: I can hear these stories, but I can't say I remember them.
exact.我不会拿它逼你认一个名字。留下的人要照护，真的离开的人，也不能说一句都能救回来。: I won't use it to pressure you into accepting a name. Those who remain deserve care, and for those who truly departed, I can't claim that every one of them can be brought back.
exact.仍是你现在的称呼。过去找到多少，都不会替你抹掉今天。: It's still what I call you now. However much of the past we find, it won't erase your today.
exact.旧名不抹去现在的自身与相处: An old name doesn't erase who you are now or the time we share
exact.若有一天知道旧名，你会只叫那个吗？: If one day you learn your old name, will you only go by that?
exact.若找到旧名，我仍想自己决定怎样被称呼。: If I find my old name, I still want to decide for myself what I'm called.
exact.旧名找到了，现在的称呼也能留下吗？: If my old name is found, can I keep what you call me now too?
exact.可别一找到旧名，就把今天认识的我丢一边！: Don't go tossing aside the me you know today the moment we find an old name!
exact.我想知道，过去与现在能否都由我自己面对。: I want to know whether I can face both the past and the present on my own terms.
exact.从前的名字，不该把现在盖住。: A former name shouldn't bury the present.
exact.现在被认真叫着的感觉，我也想留着。: I want to keep this feeling of being called by name with real care, too.
exact.改不改称呼，得问我。: Whether my name changes is for me to decide.
exact.身份得到补充，不等于现名就不真实。: Learning more about my identity doesn't make my current name any less real.
exact.多知道一条来路，也可以继续走今天的路吧？: Even knowing one more piece of where I came from, I can still keep walking today's path, right?
exact.我怕找到从前以后，眼前这一点就不算了。: I'm afraid that once we find my past, this little bit here and now won't count anymore.
exact.不会擅自替你换。想怎么称呼，仍听你自己的意思。: I won't change it on my own. What you want to be called is still up to you.
exact.若从前的我与你想的不一样呢？: What if the old me isn't who you imagine?
exact.那就重新听你说。过去可以让我多认识一些，不能替我把现在的相处划掉。: Then I'll listen to you anew. The past can help me know you a little better, but it can't cross out the time we share now.
exact.也不要求我立刻记起来？: And you won't demand that I remember right away?
exact.不要求。知道多少说多少，今天想谈什么也由你选。: No. Tell me as much as you know, and what we talk about today is your choice too.
exact.那今天先留下这个名字。: Then for today, I'll keep this name.
exact.听见了。以后想法变了，也可以再告诉我。: Heard. If you change your mind later, you can tell me again.
exact.我想认识完整的来路，也不想为了一个答案，错过眼前正在说话的它。: I want to know the full story of where it came from, but I don't want to chase an answer and miss it, speaking right in front of me.
exact.第十六境后继续核对原始维护资料: Continue verifying the original maintenance records after the Sixteenth Realm
exact.下一处是第十七境藏纹台，查原账与改阵记录的核对依据。: Next is the Seventeenth Realm, Pattern Vault Terrace, to find a basis for cross-checking the original ledgers against the array modification records.
exact.维护身份已经有线索可查，却不能只凭一个署名，就替整件事下最后结论。: There are leads to follow on the maintenance identity, but a single signature isn't enough to reach a final conclusion on the whole affair.
exact.第十六境，沉水器冢。查失踪登记、原佩剑旧痕与已核实记载，一人一剑分别核对。: The Sixteenth Realm, Sunken Water Weapon Tomb. Examine the missing-persons register, the old marks on original swords, and verified records, checking each person and each sword separately.
exact.相似名字不是同一个身份；眼下没有能交谈的原剑，也不找替身替它回忆。: Similar names are not the same identity. Right now there is no original sword to speak with, and no stand-in will be found to remember on its behalf.
exact.独自核实化灵与维护身份: Verify spirit transformation and the maintenance identity alone
exact.失踪原簿与器物核验互证：部分失踪修士把魂魄留在原佩剑中，后来成为器灵，也有人确实: The original missing-persons register and the artifact examinations corroborate each other: some missing cultivators left their souls in their original swords and later became Weapon Spirits, while others truly died.
exact.维护印登记与回廊资料确认境主曾有完整维护权，最终受益因果仍需另证。: The maintenance seal registry and the corridor records confirm that the Realm Lord once held full maintenance authority. Who ultimately benefited, and how, still requires separate proof.
exact.这些结论只属于对应的原人原剑，不给每件器物统一安排前世，更不能说死亡已经被挽回。: These conclusions apply only to the corresponding people and their original swords. They do not assign a past life to every artifact, and they certainly do not mean any death has been undone.
exact.独自思考过去与当下: Reflect alone on the past and the present
exact.知道过去能让人多认识一些，却不该抹掉今天。若旧剑有一天想谈，我想先听它想怎样被称: Knowing the past can help someone understand more, but it shouldn't erase today. If the old sword someday wants to talk, I want to first hear how it wishes to be called.
exact.眼下没有人替它回答，我也不预先写好它的意愿。: Right now no one can answer for it, and I won't write its wishes in advance.
exact.先顾好这一刻，等真正能交流时再认真问。: Take care of this moment first, and when we can truly communicate, I'll ask in earnest.
exact.独自准备第十七境: Prepare alone for the Seventeenth Realm
exact.下一趟到藏纹台查原账与改阵资料。尚未核对清楚的部分继续留着，不让急切替我定案。: Next trip, go to the Pattern Vault Terrace to examine the original ledgers and array modification records. Whatever hasn't been verified stays open; I won't let impatience settle the case for me.
exact.调查记录按对应的人与原佩剑保存；不会替随身器灵改名、认主或恢复前世。: Investigation records are kept under the corresponding person and original sword. No companion Weapon Spirit will be renamed, made to acknowledge a master, or restored to a past life on its behalf.
exact.第十七境整理校对依据不提前定案: Seventeenth Realm: compile the verification basis without settling the case early
exact.第十七境，藏纹台。这次查原账与改阵记录，也弄清接下来该怎样核对当前流向。: The Seventeenth Realm, Pattern Vault Terrace. This time, examine the original ledgers and array modification records, and work out how to verify the current flows next.
exact.旧记录和眼下还差一次对照。这趟先把能核对的依据留好。: The old records still need one more comparison against the present. This trip, secure the evidence that can be checked first.
exact.也给别的话留一点地方。: And leave a little room for other things to say.
exact.该查的继续查，我也想留些时间说自己的打算。: We'll keep investigating what needs investigating, but I also want some time to talk about my own plans.
exact.我想在调查之外，也与你说一点平常的事。: Beyond the investigation, I'd like to talk with you about ordinary things too.
exact.别整天只剩线索！我还有别的想问。: Don't let every day be nothing but clues! I've got other things to ask.
exact.我愿把依据理清，也希望今天不只有调查。: I'm willing to sort out the evidence, but I hope today isn't only about investigating.
exact.事情慢慢查，日子也要过。: The investigation can take its time; life still has to be lived.
exact.准备要做，歇息和盼头也别挤没了。: Preparations need doing, but don't let them crowd out rest and things to look forward to.
exact.查完这段，我要说点别的。: Once this part is checked, I've got something else to say.
exact.还差的核对别省，我想谈的话也别漏。: Don't skip the checks still left, and don't leave out what I want to talk about either.

exact.无低血护持时，综合生存 =（气血上限 + 持续回血/秒 × 10 秒）÷ 加权承: Without low-health wards, overall survival = (maximum HP + continuous healing/s × 10 s) ÷ weighted damage taken ratio. This is the total raw damage survivable from full HP under continuous small hits over 10 s. The fixed reference is physical 62% and spell 38%; both use Metal 20%, Wood 20%, Water 20%, Fire 20%, Earth 20% for elemental damage taken. It includes both defenses, effective elemental resistance and damage taken multipliers; immunity to one element only removes that element's share. The reference uses the same realm with no attacker affinity or elemental advantage, and does not represent this stage's enemies. With low-health wards, each actual health band uses its strongest reduction and continuous healing to find the incoming damage required to exhaust full HP. A large first hit crossing a health threshold gets no retroactive protection. Only continuous healing with no waiting period is included. Healing while unharmed, movement speed, steady stance, knockback resistance and other conditional benefits are listed separately. Healing while unharmed requires a continuous period without damage, not leaving combat.

exact.这把叫「{newSword}」。你愿意的话，去和它聊几句吧。: This one is called "{newSword}." If you'd like, go have a chat with it.
exact.这把是「{newSword}」。以后一起走，你也去问候一声吧。: This is "{newSword}." Since we'll be traveling together from now on, go give it a greeting.
exact.这把是「{newSword}」。多了一位同行的，你也去和它说说话吧。: This is "{newSword}." Now that we have another companion on the road, go say a few words to it.
exact.这把的名字是「{newSword}」。我只替你引见，别的还要听它自己说。: This blade's name is "{newSword}." I'm only making the introduction—the rest is for it to tell you itself.
exact.这是此处符座的一次静息观察，不能归因为刚才的移动或御剑耗用；尚不清楚旁路的用途。: This is a quiet observation at the local rune plinth, not caused by your recent movement or sword control; the purpose of the bypass remains unclear.
exact.这次历练已经结束。返回山门，准备好后再试。: This expedition has ended. Return to the Mountain Gate and try again when ready.
exact.这次我也想提个办法。: I'd like to suggest an idea this time, too.
exact.这里只取得护持原理与纹路观测；救母的完整来路还须家事和两段出境记录互证。: Here we've only obtained the protection principle and pattern observation; the full story of Mother's rescue still requires cross-checking the family notes and both exit logs.
exact.这里只见到这一缕流向。它往哪里去、别处是否也一样，还得继续查。: Only this single thread of current is visible here. Where it leads—and whether other places are the same—will take further investigation.
exact.这里查看气血、灵力、攻击与防御。属性用于了解当前角色状态。: Check your HP, SP, Attack, and Defense here. Stats let you review your character's current condition.
exact.这里记录的是家中资料本身，还没有同交接原录互证；旧剑没有因此记起过去。: This records the family notes themselves, which have not yet been cross-checked against the original handover log; the old sword has not regained its past memories from this.
exact.远侧符座保存器物旧痕、已核实的零碎残忆和维护印登记。: The far-side rune plinth preserves relic wear marks, verified fragmentary memories, and the maintenance-seal registry.
exact.远侧符座保存旧护魂法；停步、停止御剑后，可核对现存护持纹路。: The far-side rune plinth preserves the old soul-guarding art; stop moving and pause flying-sword attacks to verify the existing protective pattern.
exact.选择这把新剑，再用【与器灵聊聊】或器物详情的交谈入口与它对话。是否交谈由你决定，: Select this new sword, then use "Talk to Spirit" or the chat button in its item details to speak with it. Talking is optional and does not require binding.
exact.那先说眼下的。: Then let's start with what's right in front of us.
exact.那就不甘心一会儿。: Then let's just sit with that frustration for a moment.
exact.那就互相提醒。总比两边都不肯开口强。: Then we'll remind each other. That's much better than neither of us speaking up.
exact.那就从眼前开始。你现在最想让我听的，是哪件事？: Then let's start with the present. What's the one thing you most want me to hear right now?
exact.那就先留住这一点。你不用替记录讲完全部旧事，我也不会催你。: Then let's just hold on to this much for now. You don't have to fill in the whole past for the records, and I won't rush you.
exact.那就先说还拿不准的。: Then let's start with what we're still unsure about.
exact.那就各说各的。我不会把你们当成同一个声音。: Then each of you can speak for yourself. I won't treat you as the same voice.
exact.那就把你的感受说给我听，不用勉强跟着我的话走。: Then tell me how it feels to you—no need to force yourself to follow my lead.
exact.那就换我提醒。总不能只有你记着，我负责把毛病留给你。: Then it's my turn to remind you. I can't leave all the remembering to you while I just hand you the trouble.
exact.那就照现在的称呼来。知道一个名字，不是让你把以后的话都欠给我。: Then we'll stick with what we call each other now. Knowing a name doesn't mean you owe me every word from here on.
exact.那就都记着。难得是为了想过的日子盘算，总不能又变成赶着交差。: Then we'll keep both in mind. Planning for the days we want to live shouldn't turn into another rushed chore.
exact.那我们就把这两件事分开说，不急着替你下结论。: Then we'll keep those two things separate and not rush to conclusions for you.
exact.那我就歇一会儿。你想到什么，再叫我。: Then I'll rest for a bit. Call me whenever something comes to mind.
exact.那我说件小事吧。以前练完剑，我常对着剑自言自语，想想哪儿还能练好些。: Then let me share something small. Back when I finished sword practice, I used to talk to my blade and think about where I could do better.
exact.那时的事，我不记得。: I don't remember what happened back then.
exact.那现在问谁？: Then who are you asking now?
exact.那练来做什么？: Then what do we practice for?
exact.那轮到你。现在想说什么，不必顺着我这件事来。: Then it's your turn. Say whatever's on your mind right now—no need to follow my topic.
exact.都有点。下回若忘了什么，你可以提醒我，但不用什么都替我记着。: A bit of both. Next time I forget something, you can remind me—but you don't have to carry every memory for me.
exact.镜庭符座上保留旧阵用途与修缮刻记。: The Mirror Court rune plinth preserves inscriptions on the old formation's purpose and repairs.
exact.阵位放飞剑等攻击器物，穿戴栏放角色装备。配装随时可以自行调整。: Formation slots hold attacking relics like flying swords, while gear slots hold character armor. You can adjust your loadout at any time.
exact.共鸣已退出新随机池；旧物仍可按原规则扩大本剑实际命中长度与宽度，不加索敌距离，也: Resonance has been retired from new random pools; existing items still expand this sword's actual hit length and width under original rules, without increasing target acquisition range, single-hit blood-drink ratio, or per-channel recovery caps.
exact.同主人另一水主装备有效命中并留下潮记后，共潮可按「两岸应声」当前倍率增强命中；实: After another Water-primary piece of the same Master lands a valid hit and leaves a Tide Mark, Shared Tide boosts hits by the current Echoing Shores multiplier; consumed upon reducing HP or armor, and retained if fully absorbed by shields. See this relic's effect card for multipliers and full conditions.
exact.固刃增加本剑器命上限；长生枝没有持续燃命或低器命增伤，普通随机以修复与护生为主，: Firm Edge increases this sword's Max Blade HP; Longevity Branch has no continuous HP burn or low-HP damage bonus, so standard rolls focus on repair and protection rather than capacity. Raising Max Blade HP does not increase outward repair ratios or per-channel recovery caps.
exact.惜薪只调整获准的燃柴费用，饮绯的血契不在适用范围，因此保持禁止。饮绯已有专属缓契: Kindling Thrift only adjusts eligible kindling costs and does not apply to Crimson Drinker's Blood Pact. Crimson Drinker uses its own Pact Relief when Blade HP at step start is above 0 and strictly below 25% of max; low-HP damage thresholds, zero-HP return, and relaunch thresholds remain unchanged.
exact.提高本剑合法接触的暴击机会，最终暴击率仍最多75%；真实扣血才供饮血，自修与主人: Increases critical hit chance on valid contacts (capped at 75% total); only actual HP lost feeds blood-drinking, with self-repair and Master healing each capped by the primary strike's recovery limit. Misses, zero-damage hits, and overkill do not feed blood.
exact.暴击增伤只提高本剑本次真实扣血；可间接增加尚未封顶的饮血回补，自修与主人治疗各受: Critical damage bonus only increases actual HP dealt by this hit; it can indirectly boost uncapped blood-drink recovery within each channel's cap and missing HP, while overkill damage grants no recovery.
exact.流光加快饮绯近主受灵，也提高本剑已有的外飞器气自回；受灵仍由主人支付，自回不扣主: Flowing Light speeds up Crimson Drinker's near-Master SP transfer and boosts its deployed Blade Qi self-recovery; transferred SP is still paid by the Master, self-recovery costs no Master SP, and neither repairs Blade HP lost while deployed.
exact.物理增伤提高本剑真实扣血，可间接供剑体自修和主人治疗；两路各受本主击当前回复上限: Physical damage bonus increases actual HP dealt, indirectly feeding blade self-repair and Master healing within each channel's cap and deficit; zero-damage, shield-only hits, and overkill grant no recovery, and base recovery ratios remain unchanged.
exact.纯金点伤增加本剑可结算的接触伤害，实际多扣的敌人生命可间接供饮血；自修与主人治疗: Flat Metal damage adds to this sword's contact damage, and the extra enemy HP dealt can indirectly feed blood-drinking within each channel's cap and deficit; invulnerable, zero-damage, and overkill hits grant no recovery.
exact.金增伤服务饮绯本器已有纯金伤害；实际扣血可间接增加回补，但不提高吸取比例，自修与: Metal damage bonus scales Crimson Drinker's innate Metal damage; actual HP dealt can indirectly increase recovery without raising leech ratios, capped by each channel's limit and deficit.
exact.长生枝实际绑定轻伤自修与共生友修；养刃只在已有工序的实伤修复贡献中增幅一次，两路: Longevity Branch binds light-wound self-repair and symbiotic ally repair; Edge Nourishment amplifies actual damage-based repair once without changing per-channel recovery caps, Master HP, or damage.
exact.长生枝的剑击按术法结算；明法提高本剑伤害，实际多扣掉的气血可供自修和友修，各自仍: Longevity Branch strikes resolve as spell damage; Clear Art increases this sword's damage, and extra HP dealt feeds self-repair and ally repair within each channel's cap and Blade HP deficit.
exact.额外支付主人灵力换取直接火伤，并采用本器独立收束冷却；具体数值由「借火还餐」效果: Spends extra Master SP for direct Fire damage using this relic's own cooldown, with values held by Borrowed Fire. Base and extra costs are paid once when the action commits, while delivery, animation, and active cap still limit cast frequency.
exact.饮绯可随机缓契，只缓解本器严格低于25%危急窗的外飞器命费用；不改低器命效果的增: Crimson Drinker can roll Pact Relief, reducing deployed Blade HP cost only while strictly below 25% Max Blade HP; low-HP damage thresholds and relaunch thresholds remain unchanged.
exact.饮绯的血契持续消耗器命，受援可让伙伴帮它维持更稳妥的器命水平。修复后可能达到本剑: Crimson Drinker's Blood Pact continuously drains Blade HP, and Aid lets companion blades help keep its Blade HP stable. Repairs may raise Blade HP above its low-HP bonus threshold; Aid does not boost blood-drinking or Master healing.
exact.饮绯：血契按飞行耗损叶的当前速率消耗本剑器命，固刃增加有限余量；低命效果按当前比: Crimson Drinker: Blood Pact drains Blade HP at the current flight-wear rate, and Firm Edge adds extra buffer; low-HP bonuses scale by percentage thresholds, so changing max capacity shifts entry and exit windows.
exact.饮绯：饮血回补确实能治疗主人，养命可增加主人容纳这些治疗的生命上限；不增加本剑器: Crimson Drinker: Blood-drink recovery heals the Master, and Life Nourishment raises the Master's Max HP to hold that healing; it does not increase Blade HP, and low-HP bonuses still check this sword's own Blade HP ratio.
exact.法术 DLC02 首批开放离火术法、沧冰术法。「九霄敕雷」「负岳不归」保留 GM: Magic DLC02 initially unlocks Blazing Arts and Glacial Arts. "Nine Heavens Thunder Edict" and "Mountain Bearer's Last Stand" remain available via GM grant; normal acquisition in new runs does not yet include these Divine Artifacts.
exact.修行内容暂未就绪，请重新尝试。: Expedition content is not ready yet. Please try again.

exact.扩展内容 配置已改变，初始化新修行？: Expansion Settings Changed — Start a New Run?
exact.法术 扩展内容02 首批开放离火术法、沧冰术法。「九霄敕雷」「负岳不归」保留 调: Magic DLC02 initially unlocks Blazing Arts and Glacial Arts. "Nine Heavens Thunder Edict" and "Mountain Bearer's Last Stand" remain available via GM grant; normal acquisition in new runs does not yet include these Divine Artifacts.
exact.本境目标：存活至计时结束。: Goal: survive until the timer ends.
exact.键盘：WASD／方向键移动。手柄：左摇杆。触屏：移动摇杆。: Keyboard: WASD / arrow keys. Controller: left stick. Touch: movement stick.
exact.先走出几步，再换个方向。: Take a few steps, then change direction.
exact.按空格／手柄跳跃键／触屏跳跃，完成一次起跳与落地。: Press Space, the controller jump button, or the touch jump button, then land.
exact.跳跃不保证免伤，仍需走位避开攻击。: Jumping does not guarantee safety; keep moving to avoid attacks.
exact.点按下方旧剑，先关闭自动攻击，再点一次开启。: Select the old sword below to turn auto attack off, then select it again to turn it on.
exact.手柄可用 RT 聚焦旧剑，再按确认切换。开启后，飞剑按自身状态出击与返回。: On a controller, use RT to focus the sword and confirm to toggle it. The sword attacks and returns according to its current state.
exact.依次查看下方“命”（自身气血）、“灵”（自身灵力）和旧剑（器命／灵力）。: Inspect Health, Spirit Power, and the old sword's durability / spirit.
exact.鼠标悬停，或用 Tab／手柄 RT 聚焦；触屏轻触命、灵，长按旧剑。: Hover with the mouse, or focus with Tab / controller RT. On touch, tap the orbs and hold the sword.
exact.靠近并收取一份实际掉落；暂时没有掉落时继续应敌。: Approach and collect a drop. Keep fighting if none are nearby.
exact.存活至本境计时结束即通关，不必清空敌人或寻找出口。: Survive until the timer ends to clear this realm; you do not need to defeat every enemy or find an exit.
exact.先收拾行装，再赴下一境。: Prepare your gear before entering the next realm.
exact.【行囊】查看随身器物，【属性】查看角色数值。左侧可切换【渡灵商人】和【远征仓库】: Open Inventory for carried items or Stats for your character. Switch between the Spirit Merchant and Expedition Stash on the left; view attack slots and equipped armor on the right.
exact.双击购买武器、防具时会尝试自动装备；条件不合适时留在背包，请复查实际阵位与穿戴结: Double-clicking to buy weapons or armor attempts to equip them. If they cannot be equipped, they stay in your inventory; check the actual slots afterward.
exact.薪玉是武器强化材料，不是货币。携带它不攻击，也不增加战斗属性。: Kindling Jade is a weapon upgrade material, not currency. Carrying it neither attacks nor grants combat stats.
exact.双击已拥有的武器或防具，尝试装备到合适位置；武器也可拖入可用阵位。: Double-click an owned weapon or armor piece to equip it in a suitable slot. You can also drag a weapon into an available attack slot.
exact.双击已装备的器物，可在行囊有空位时卸下。: Double-click equipped gear to remove it if your inventory has room.
exact.确认武器已装备、自动攻击已开启，并放妥手持器物。: Check that your weapons are equipped, auto attack is on, and any held item is put away.
exact.准备好后点【下一关】出发；暂时离开则点【保存并离开】，等待保存完成。: Choose Next Realm when ready. To leave, choose Save & Leave and wait for saving to finish.
exact.使用WASD／方向键移动，沿青石路向前。: Use WASD / Arrow Keys to move forward along the bluestone path.
exact.手柄：左摇杆。触屏：移动摇杆。: Gamepad: Left Stick. Touchscreen: Movement Joystick.
exact.前方有台阶，按空格跳上去。: There are steps ahead. Press Space to jump up.
exact.点按下方飞剑卡片，开启或关闭自动追踪攻击。: Tap the flying sword card below to toggle auto-tracking attacks on or off.
exact.左下方‘命’显示气血，右下方‘灵’显示灵力。: 'Life' at the bottom left shows HP, and 'Spirit' at the bottom right shows Spirit Power.
